policies.title: Policies
policies.intro: Cancelling, holidays, breakages and paying, written down.

sections.heading: Cancelling or moving a visit
sections.text: Tell us 48 hours before and there's no charge. Later than that, we charge half the visit, because your cleaner has kept the time for you.

sections.heading: Holidays
sections.text: Pause your visits whenever you go away; tell us a week before. Your cleaner keeps your slot.

sections.heading: Breakages
sections.text: If we break something, we tell you that day and put it right. We'd rather you heard it from us than found it.

sections.heading: Putting things right
sections.text: If a room isn't done to the list, tell us within 48 hours and we come back to do it, free.

sections.heading: Paying
sections.text: By card or bank transfer after each visit. You get a receipt by email every time.

offices.title: Offices
offices.intro: Offices, studios and shops cleaned outside your hours, by the same team each time. Priced after a free site survey.
offices.message: Hello Brook, we'd like a site survey for our office.

cleaners.title: Our cleaners
cleaners.intro: Employed by us, not agency staff.

sections.heading: Employed, paid for the time
sections.text: Our cleaners are employed by us, paid by the hour including travel between homes.

sections.heading: Checked before they start
sections.text: Two references, right to work and a basic DBS check, all before a first visit.

sections.heading: Insured
sections.text: Public liability insurance covers every visit; we send the certificate on request.

sections.heading: Trained to the list
sections.text: Every new cleaner works alongside a supervisor for their first two weeks, room by room, to the same list you see on our site.

items.title: What agents check at check-out
items.intro: The ten things that come up most on check-out reports, and how long each takes to put right.

sections.heading: Ovens first
sections.text: The oven comes up on almost every report. It is also the longest single job in a move-out clean: an hour or more for a used oven, so book it in.

sections.heading: Limescale
sections.text: Taps, shower screens and the base of the toilet. Descaling takes time to work; it is not a wipe.

sections.heading: Behind and under
sections.text: Agents pull out what moves. We clean behind the appliances we can move safely and tell you about the ones we can't.

items.title: Keeping a home clean between visits
items.intro: Ten minutes a day that make a fortnightly clean feel weekly.

sections.heading: Surfaces clear
sections.text: We clean what we can reach. Clear worktops on cleaning day and the time goes on cleaning, not moving things.

sections.heading: Squeegee the shower
sections.text: Thirty seconds after each shower keeps limescale off the screen for a fortnight.

bill.title: The bill, worked out in front of you.
bill.intro: Time on site at our hourly rate, rounded once to the pound. Extras add their own minutes.
bill.fine: A guide from our published rates; we confirm it before the first visit. Regular cleans have no contract.

keys.title: Your key, accounted for.
keys.intro: Most of our clients are out when we clean. Every movement of a key is logged, and you can ask for the log at any time.

services.title: What we clean.
services.intro: Homes first, offices outside their hours.

areas.title: Where we clean.
areas.intro: Eight postcode districts in south-west London, so your cleaner is never far away.

included.title: What every clean includes
included.intro: Room by room, the same list every visit, and how long each room takes.

messages.general: Hello Brook, I have a question.
messages.price: Hello Brook, could I have a price for a clean?

questions.q: Do I need to be in?
questions.a: No. Most of our clients are out. We hold a numbered key, or use your key safe. See how a key moves, above.

questions.q: Will I have the same cleaner?
questions.a: Yes. When they're away we tell you who's covering a week before.

questions.q: Do you bring products and equipment?
questions.a: Yes: our own vacuums, cloths and products, fragrance-free unless you ask. If you'd like us to use yours, leave them out.
Not for regular cleans. Pause or stop with a week's notice. Offices have a written agreement after the site survey.

items.name: Regular cleaning
items.line: Weekly or fortnightly, the same cleaner, the same list every visit.

page.intro: Weekly or fortnightly, by the same cleaner, to the same written list.
page.takes: 2 h 25 for a two-bedroom flat with two bathrooms

photo.alt: A white bathroom with a pale blue bath under a sash window

sections.heading: The same cleaner
sections.text: You meet your cleaner on the first visit and they come every time after. When they're on holiday we tell you who's covering a week ahead, and they get the same list.

sections.heading: The same list
sections.text: Every room has its tasks and its minutes, written down on our what's-included page. If you'd like something done first, leave a note.

sections.heading: Rates
sections.text: £24 an hour weekly, £25 fortnightly. The shortest visit we book is two hours. No contract: pause or stop with a week's notice.

items.name: Deep cleans
items.line: One visit, every room taken further: inside cupboards, grout, behind and under.

page.intro: A one-off visit that takes every room further than a regular clean.
page.takes: Half as long again as a regular visit, room by room

photo.alt: A marble shower and a timber basin, wiped and dry

sections.heading: What changes
sections.text: Each room takes half as long again: inside cupboards and wardrobes, grout scrubbed, behind and under furniture we can move safely, skirting and door frames by hand.

sections.heading: Before regular cleans
sections.text: Many homes start with one deep clean, then regular visits keep it there. It isn't required; we'll tell you honestly if your home needs one.

items.name: End of tenancy
items.line: Empty-property cleans to the check-out list most agents use.

page.intro: An empty-property clean, room by room, to the list agents and landlords check against.
page.takes: Most of a day for a two-bedroom flat

sections.heading: The checklist
sections.text: Our end-of-tenancy page has the full room-by-room list, and what to do before we arrive. Tick it off as you go.

sections.heading: If something is missed
sections.text: Tell us within 72 hours of the clean and we come back to put it right, free. We can't promise what a landlord decides about a deposit; we can make sure the clean isn't the reason.

items.name: Short-let turnovers
items.line: Between guests: cleaned, beds changed, restocked, photographed for you.

page.intro: Between guests, in the gap between check-out and check-in.
page.takes: About 2 hours for a one-bedroom flat

photo.alt: A made bed with white sheets against a dark panelled wall

sections.heading: Every turnover
sections.text: A full clean, beds changed with your linen, towels set out, consumables restocked from your cupboard, and photos of each room sent to you before we leave.

sections.heading: Tight gaps
sections.text: Send us your check-out and check-in times when you book. If a gap is too tight for the flat, we'll say so rather than rush it.

items.name: After builders
items.line: Dust from every surface after building work, in two passes.

page.intro: After building or decorating work: dust off every surface, in two passes a day apart.

sections.heading: Two passes
sections.text: Fine dust settles for a day after the first clean. We come back the next day to take off what has settled.

sections.heading: What we need
sections.text: The builders finished, rubble gone, power and water on. We bring the vacuums with the right filters.

items.text: Same cleaner every fortnight, and the flat is done properly when we get home.
